description: The 1207.14 MHz band: Galileo E5b (I/NAV), BDS B2b (B-CNAV3, and PPP-B2b null messages on the GEO satellites) and BDS B2I (D1/D2 of the BDS-2 satellites) in a 25 MHz IQ4 stream; static receiver, 5 s. It starts at 02:12 UTC on 2026-03-20 on the older window brd4_2026079_0200.rnx, whose first Galileo data sets go on air at 02:11 GPST: since the April 2026 restructuring of the BDS PRNs no satellite transmits B2I.
name: e5b_b2b_b2i_band
